name: À nouveau
source:
Based in 18th century France, Jules and Adelaide Abraham are a young couple just trying to get by. While out on a walk one evening, they suddenly find themselves thrust into a horrific encounter with unknown beings only to realize they are stuck in a repeating nightmare. Jules -- The only one who remembers the deadly altercation  -- must find a way to keep both him and his beloved wife safe while battling his own dwindling health. 

[From [url=https://minilycan.itch.io/anouveau]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在18世纪的法国，儒勒·亚伯拉罕与阿德莱德·亚伯拉罕是一对勉力维持生计的年轻夫妻。某天傍晚外出散步时，两人突然遭遇了未知存在的恐怖袭击，回过神来却发现自己被困在了一场周而复始的噩梦之中。儒勒——唯一记得那场致命冲突的人——必须在自身健康日渐衰弱的困境下，设法护住自己与挚爱妻子的周全。

[摘自[url=https://minilycan.itch.io/anouveau]itch.io[/url]]
